messages:
devon: opening a war room — seeing 503s + gateway timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west since ~09:12 UTC. customer reports API errors and timeouts, p95 latency ~12s. @anya can you confirm?

anya: confirmed. Alerts fired at 09:11. Pattern: 503 from gateway, some 504s from runtime pods. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Early logs show repeated "kv-cache timed out" and socket errors (connection reset by peer). Looks correlated with a high-throughput batched job.

sarah: customer details from support: acct_6789, started seeing failures at 09:10 after a heavy backfill. They provided a quick repro (curl):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","input":"long prompt...","max_tokens":1024}'
```

mike: throwing in some infra metrics — runtime pod CPU ok, but we see backlog growing in the batcher queue and kv-cache latency for prefix reads jumping to 700ms. There are also a few nodes showing TLS handshake errors to the cache tier.

ops-bot: deploy/rollback triggered by devon: rolled back canary -> commit abc123.

devon: mitigation done — rolled the canary back and scaled up dedicated pool by +4 instances. Immediate error rate dropped from 8% -> 0.7% over 6m. Need to track customer impact and follow up with root cause.

anya: repro steps for eng: 1) run the customer's backfill pattern (200rps sustained, large batches) 2) observe kv-cache tail latency and batcher queue depth 3) capture runtime pod logs with `LEVEL=debug` and enable prefix-cache trace.

eng-oncall: logs collected: runtime shows repeated timeouts to cache: "GET /kv/prefix failed: context deadline exceeded". Suspect connection pool exhaustion between runtime and cache under bursty large-batch traffic.

mike: temporary workaround for hosted: reduce default batch size for affected models and lower batch timeout to 60ms, also increase cache connection pool from 50 -> 150. Planning a config rollout to eu-west only.

devon: customer communication: support notified acct_6789 at 09:30, apologized and described mitigations. They were advised to throttle large backfills until patch.

anya: suggested action items (short):
- A1: increase cache connection pool and add circuit breaker on kv-cache requests (assigned: eng-oncall)
- A2: add alert for prefix-cache p99 latency > 200ms (assigned: mike)
- A3: tune batcher default batch_size for high-throughput customers (assigned: devex)
- A4: reproduce in staging with synthetic backfill and run load profile (assigned: eng-ml)
- A5: postmortem doc & customer RCA (assigned: sarah)

eng-oncall: taking A1 and will open PR for pool size + circuit-breaker config. ETA ~4h.

mike: taking A2, will add dashboard tile and alert, ETA 2h.

devon: thanks all. tagging this for postmortem and follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Will close war room once postmortem is in progress and customer confirmed degraded behavior cleared. :thumbsup:

sarah: quick note — include test that stresses kv-cache prefix reads specifically, and try with TLS renegotiation disabled to rule out handshake flaps.

ops-bot: incident note created: INC-2026-0440.

mike: final checkin 12:24 UTC — 503s resolved, customer confirms normal traffic. leaving action items open for implementation and postmortem writeup. :white_check_mark:
